stem: Rohan adds in a base-$5$ landmark system. In the ones place he holds $5$ copies of the $1$-landmark.

parts.text: Which claim is correct before he reads the sum?

options.text: Leave the $5$ ones unexchanged and read five ones as the ones digit.
Exchange the $5$ ones for one copy of the $5$-landmark, then read the sum.
Call the step regrouping and stop after naming that label.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: In base 5, five copies of one landmark equal one copy of the next landmark, so the ones must be exchanged before the sum is read.

teacher.key_rationale: Base-5 addition regroups 5 ones into one five-landmark. Leaving them unexchanged or stopping at the regrouping label misses that exchange.
